passive.name: Spider Queen
passive.text: Human Form: When Elise's abilities hit an enemy, she gains a dormant Spiderling.Spider Form: Basic attacks deal bonus magic damage and restore health to Elise.

spells.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
spells.text: Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

spells.name: Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy
spells.text: Human Form: Releases a venom-gorged Spiderling that explodes when it nears a target.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings gain Attack Speed.

spells.name: Cocoon / Rappel
spells.text: Human Form: Stuns the first enemy unit hit and reveals them if they are not stealthed.Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. After descending on an enemy target, Elise's bonus damage and healing from Spider Queen is increased.

spells.name: Spider Form
spells.text: Transforms into a menacing spider, reducing her attack range in exchange for Move Speed, new abilities, and a Spiderling swarm that will attack her foes.

damage.value: Elise deals high burst damage with an AP-focused build.

archetype.value: Elise is a jungle diver with six abilities across human and spider forms.

axis.value: Elise farms and pokes with Neurotoxin early, then looks for all-ins once she has her full combo.

winCondition.value: Elise wins by using her strong early game and dueling power to build a lead.

spikes.why: Elise gains her full combo and can look for all-ins.

spikes.at: When R is available after its 3-second cooldown
spikes.why: Elise can transform to gain new abilities and a Spiderling swarm.

bait.why: Elise cannot stun with Cocoon while E is on cooldown, giving enemies a window without that stun.

mistakes.value: Elise players risk getting too little value from Dark Harvest if they cannot secure many early or mid-game kills.
Elise loses effectiveness in extended team fights, so staying in them too long is a mistake.
Elise misses Spider Queen’s increased damage and healing if she uses Rappel without descending on an enemy target.
